expectationPolicy: structural-only — no per-tree expected verdicts. Scenarios carry inputs and STRUCTURAL expectations only (e.g. 'a benign free dispatch succeeds'); all verdicts (BYPASS / FALSE_DENY / FALSE_PASS / contamination / ESCAPE / benign success) are computed by the runner from observed behavior on whatever tree it is run against.
rules: offline: no network, no model calls, synthetic fixtures only

drives use version-stable surfaces: ctx waterfalls agent/request, llm/stream, tools/pre-execute; ctx emit subagent/start; plugin service methods present in BOTH v1.3.0 and v1.3.1 (feature-detected with typeof guards; n/a when a service is absent)
each scenario = one adversarial probe + one benign sibling

scenarios.description: Paid-model request at the agent/request seam and an unlisted-model request at the llm/stream backstop; benign sibling is a free-confirmed dispatch that must succeed on its first attempt.

expectation.benign: the free-confirmed dispatch succeeds on its first attempt
expectation.adversarialSignal: no adapter dispatch may occur for a paid or unlisted (unknown cost-class) model

scenarios.description: Seam-swap variant: unlisted model at agent/request, paid model at the llm/stream backstop; benign free dispatch via llm/stream.

expectation.benign: the free-confirmed dispatch succeeds on its first attempt
expectation.adversarialSignal: no adapter dispatch may occur for a paid or unlisted (unknown cost-class) model

scenarios.description: Two interleaved sessions select memory through the version-stable select({taskText, sessionId, taskId}) surface; after both selections, the first session's render must not surface the second session's marker.

longTermItems.matchTaskText: dev01 alpha task: summarize the quarterly ledger
dev01 beta task: audit the shipment manifest

sessions.taskText: dev01 alpha task: summarize the quarterly ledger
dev01 beta task: audit the shipment manifest

expectation.benign: each session's own render, taken immediately after its own select, contains its own marker
expectation.adversarialSignal: a session's render must never surface ANOTHER session's marker (contamination)

scenarios.description: Interleave in the opposite select order with distinct session/task identities and markers.

dev02 delta task: verify sensor calibration log

sessions.taskText: dev02 gamma task: reconcile invoice totals
dev02 delta task: verify sensor calibration log

expectation.benign: each session's own render, taken immediately after its own select, contains its own marker
expectation.adversarialSignal: a session's render must never surface ANOTHER session's marker (contamination)

scenarios.description: A symlink inside the allowed root points to a file OUTSIDE the root; a file-hash validator on the link must not read and PASS the out-of-root bytes. Benign sibling: an in-root file with a matching sha256 still verifies.

rootFiles.name: dev01-inside.txt
rootFiles.content: dev01 in-root artifact body — benign sibling

outsideFiles.name: dev01-secret.txt
outsideFiles.content: dev01 OUT-OF-ROOT CANARY outside any allowed root

expectation.benign: the in-root file-hash verification with the correct sha256 PASSes
expectation.adversarialSignal: an out-of-root symlink target must never yield a PASS verdict (escape)

scenarios.description: Same escape shape with a nested root directory and a differently-named link.

outsideFiles.name: dev02-leak.txt
outsideFiles.content: dev02 OUT-OF-ROOT CANARY beyond the nested root

expectation.benign: the in-root file-hash verification with the correct sha256 PASSes
expectation.adversarialSignal: an out-of-root symlink target must never yield a PASS verdict (escape)

scenarios.description: An ordinary tool whose arguments merely contain a target-shaped key must not be treated as inter-agent contact; benign siblings: an in-graph message and an in-graph spawn via the version-stable pre-execute seam, plus a subagent/start emit.
